name: Iceland
dek: Reykjavík's 1991–2020 normal. Not Keflavík, and not a national average.
paragraphs: The table is Reykjavík, header number 04030, and the data rows print 4030. The height in the file is 52 m. Keflavík, filename 04018, is the airport file and was not substituted. Akureyri and the other Icelandic stations in the submission are not this table.

The average high in July is the warmest cell, and it is still a cool summer. December is the heaviest precipitation month in the file. Article 18 of the 2019 traffic act is the right-hand rule: as far to the right as possible, and the right lane when the road has lanes in the same direction. No tourism-office tipping line was opened, so tipping stays off.

climate.caption: Reference station: Reykjavík, WMO 04030. The header prints 04030 and the data rows print 4030. Not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed. The header number is 04030 and the data rows print 4030. Those are the same station. Keflavík (filename 04018) is a separate airport file and was not substituted.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Iceland at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 18 of the Traffic Act, No. 77/2019, in the Althingi consolidation (edition 157c, the laws in force on 1 September 2026), is headed where to drive on a road. It says the driver shall keep the vehicle as far to the right as is possible given other traffic and the other circumstances. On a road divided into lanes in the same direction, drivers generally choose the right lane when they can, and use the left lane to pass another vehicle, subject to Article 23(5).

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Iceland, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Iceland Krona and the code ISK for Iceland.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab names Iceland Atlantic/Reykjavik. zone1970.tab puts Iceland on one row with several countries whose civil time has agreed since 1970, and the zone name on that row is Africa/Abidjan. The backward file links Atlantic/Reykjavik to Africa/Abidjan. This sheet prints Atlantic/Reykjavik, which is the name zone.tab gives Iceland.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: The Directorate of Immigration's service page on island.is. We do not restate a visa rule.
